source_audits.coverage_note: Northern Ireland heritage-at-risk records, including listed and some unlisted buildings or monuments. Some record pages include review-year or restoration narrative but many do not expose a structured date field.

source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use only as heritage-risk/status observations, with limitations visible in the atlas evidence drawer.
